intro: White Oak, Oak, and Seasoned Hardwoods are the same price. Hickory is priced slightly higher due to limited availability, so call for current Hickory pricing. Price varies by quantity. Delivery and stacking included.

tiers.name: Quarter Cord
tiers.description: Our smallest stacked delivery. Perfect for occasional fires or a first order.

tiers.name: Face Cord
tiers.description: One row of wood stacked 8 ft long × 4 ft tall. Ideal for occasional use through the season.

tiers.name: Half Cord
tiers.description: Two rows stacked 8 ft long × 4 ft tall. The right amount for a typical residential season.

tiers.name: Full Cord
tiers.description: The standard firewood measurement: 8 ft long × 4 ft tall × 4 ft deep. Best value for heavy home use.

tiers.name: Commercial / Bulk
tiers.description: Custom quantities for restaurants, pizza ovens, BBQ kitchens, hotels, and resorts.
